description: Register the coordinator and the workers this connection is configured with.
rationale: The cluster is registered before anything is distributed: with nothing registered, Citus would place every shard on a coordinator it names localhost and then refuse to add workers. The hosts are not in this file. citus_ensure_workers reads citus.workers from the connection's section of the configuration, so the same signed bytes register two workers here and any number elsewhere; hosts_matching and min_workers bound what the unsigned configuration may supply.

intents.comment: The address the workers use to reach the coordinator.
Shards live on the workers; the coordinator routes.
The workers are exactly the configured set.
